summary.short_summary: Super Awesome, an ethically driven company backed by Epic Games, expressed interest in acquiring Ramaa Mosley's agency, which specializes in youth-led marketing and creative content. With investment capacity between $3 million and $20 million, Super Awesome seeks to build infrastructure to reach Gen Z and Gen Alpha markets while valuing cultural fit and innovative capabilities over traditional financial metrics. Ramaa's agency, founded in 2013, connects thousands of young creators and has faced revenue challenges due to client disruptions. Following a co-founder buyout, Ramaa now manages operations and is open to strategic partnerships or acquisitions that prioritize unique capabilities. Both parties plan to formalize discussions through an NDA and a follow-up call to explore potential deal structures.
